summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted a Cincinnati Enquirer item on Tom Allen training at the Buckeye House under Sherman Thurston, adding that he planned an exhibition there before leaving to meet McCoole.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'Daily Democrat, Wednesday Morning, May 26, '69'. This is before the 1875 merger.

facts.fact: Allen trained for the McCoole fight at the Buckeye House near Cincinnati under trainer Sherman Thurston, weighing about 165 pounds
Allen planned to give an exhibition in Cincinnati a few days before leaving to meet McCoole
